# jamfplatform_pro_inventory_preload_record (Data Source)

Look up a Jamf Pro Inventory Preload record by ID or by serial number. Exactly one of `id` or `serial_number` must be supplied.

**Required Jamf permissions**

Grant the API integration the following permissions in Jamf Account. `Category` and `Permission` name the section and row of the permission picker; `Actions` are the boxes to tick within that row.

| Category | Permission | Actions | API capability |
|---|---|---|---|
| Global settings | Inventory preload | Read | `inventory-preload-records` |

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Look up an Inventory Preload record by ID.
data "jamfplatform_pro_inventory_preload_record" "by_id" {
  id = "12"
}

# Look up an Inventory Preload record by device serial number.
data "jamfplatform_pro_inventory_preload_record" "by_serial" {
  serial_number = "C02ZTF001ABC"
}

output "preload_record_username" {
  value = data.jamfplatform_pro_inventory_preload_record.by_serial.username
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) Inventory Preload record ID. Mutually exclusive with `serial_number`.
- `serial_number` (String) Serial number of the device the record applies to (exact match). Mutually exclusive with `id`.
- `timeouts` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--timeouts))

### Read-Only

- `apple_care_id` (String) AppleCare ID for the device.
- `asset_tag` (String) Asset tag for the device.
- `bar_code_1` (String) Bar code 1 for the device.
- `bar_code_2` (String) Bar code 2 for the device.
- `building` (String) Building the device is assigned to.
- `department` (String) Department the device is assigned to.
- `device_type` (String) Type of device the record applies to (`Computer` or `Mobile Device`).
- `email_address` (String) Email address of the user assigned to the device.
- `extension_attributes` (Attributes List) Extension attribute values stored on the record. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--extension_attributes))
- `full_name` (String) Full name of the user assigned to the device.
- `lease_expiration` (String) Lease expiration date.
- `life_expectancy` (String) Life expectancy of the device, in years.
- `phone_number` (String) Phone number of the user assigned to the device.
- `po_date` (String) Purchase order date.
- `po_number` (String) Purchase order number.
- `position` (String) Position (job title) of the user assigned to the device.
- `purchase_price` (String) Purchase price of the device.
- `purchasing_account` (String) Purchasing account for the device.
- `purchasing_contact` (String) Purchasing contact for the device.
- `room` (String) Room the device is located in.
- `username` (String) Username assigned to the device.
- `vendor` (String) Vendor the device was purchased from.
- `warranty_expiration` (String) Warranty expiration date.

<a id="nestedatt--timeouts"></a>
### Nested Schema for `timeouts`

Optional:

- `read` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours).


<a id="nestedatt--extension_attributes"></a>
### Nested Schema for `extension_attributes`

Read-Only:

- `name` (String) Display name of the extension attribute the value applies to.
- `value` (String) Value applied to the extension attribute.
